text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This superbly talented Umamusume<n>has claimed
first place in her debut<n>race! What a bold
performance right<n>from the get-go!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I can still feel it—the intensity of those<n>final
moments, the rush of crossing<n>the finish line...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Ahaha! So this is what a race is<n>like! This is
how the turf feels under<n>my feet!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Hey, big sis! You were incredible!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie! Polly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Did you... see that? I gave it all I had...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It was so exciting! Ooooh! We<n>still kinda feel...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no doubt! Huff... I feel the...same!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I mean, my heart is still pounding like<n>crazy!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I wouldn't be surprised if the people<n>around me
could hear it beating...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(It feels just like the day when I first<n>experienced
that feeling.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text:
"Since I was born an Umamusume, I<n>always felt it
was my calling to<n>become a Derby champion."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I still remember it so clearly—I was<n>doing laundry,
and I'd just finished<n>hanging up my sister's
hoodie to dry<n>when I saw the Japanese Derby
broadcast live on TV.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Despite being covered in mud, the<n>Derby champion
was smiling happily<n>amidst the thunderous
applause.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I remember the hanger in my hand<n>making a clang
as it hit the floor.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
After the broadcast was over, I<n>rushed over to a
nearby secondhand<n>bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I picked up a magazine I'd had my<n>eye on for a
while—the Derby special<n>feature issue.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, I stood there<n>reading it until the
sun went down, my<n>heart thumping noisily the
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Interview Transcript
text_block_list.text:
"For us Umamusume, there's one<n>title that we all
dream of acquiring."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've never forgotten those words...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Not even once, since the day I read<n>them!

Once the race is over, we see Ines<n>Fujin's little
sisters off before<n>making our way back to the
academy.

Thoughts begin roaming around in my<n>head as I
consider which Open race<n>we should enter next
based on her<n>performance today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I want to take on the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I want to win the Derby!<n>I want to feel
all the excitement that<n>comes with competing on
that grand<n>stage!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's something all Umamusume<n>dream of, and I'm
no exception. I'm<n>going to enter it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And I'm going to win!
Her keen enthusiasm takes me by<n>surprise.

In stark contrast to the soft warmth<n>she had
radiated previously, her eyes<n>now appear to be
burning with a<n>fierce intensity.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer—how can I reach that<n>point? What is
it that I need?

The things she lacks, first and<n>foremost, are
experience and racing<n>instinct.

The quickest way to establish those<n>qualities would
be to have her<n>compete in a G1 race where
Umamusume vie for the title of junior<n>champion.

For example, a race like the Asahi Hai<n>Futurity
Stakes...
choice_data_list:
(...Can we really aim for a G1 race right off the
bat?)

text_block_list.text:
I'm a newbie trainer, and she's an<n>Umamusume
who only just made her<n>debut.

Junior year G1 races are filled with<n>Umamusume
who boast incredible<n>innate talent. And many have
been<n>honing their skills since a young age.

Considering our current level, it might<n>be an overly
ambitious goal.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Which race should I enter next?

However, I need to meet her<n>determined gaze with
a direct<n>challenge.
choice_data_list: Want to shoot for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?
Want to shoot for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! The Asahi Hai Futurity<n>Stakes it is! We'd
better start<n>preparing right away!
Upon hearing her response, I steel my<n>own resolve.

The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes is a<n>1,600-meter race
on turf, where<n>competitors vie for the title of junior
year champion.

We'll use it as a stepping stone on<n>her way to the
winning the Derby.
